<thought>The dominant ion is at m/z 193.1103, which in positive‑mode ESI most likely corresponds to [M + H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ≈192.103 Da. A formula consisting of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen that matches this mass is C₈H₁₆O₅ (exact monoisotopic mass = 192.0998 Da, within a few millidaltons of the observed value). This formula also yields a reasonable double‑bond equivalent (DBE = 1). Hence the molecular formula is C8H16O5.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H16O5</final_answer>
